$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors.

avatar.description: An emoji; absent, the UI shows the name's initial.

accountKey.description: Names the bot's Sessions and its `<key>_session` and `<key>_account_id` cookies; every stored Account is written under it. Changing it after the first deploy signs every User out and loses Guests' Accounts.

soul.description: The agent's Soul; absent, BotCube's own.

instructions.description: A file of the bot's instructions to every User, relative to this file, joined to the system prompt after BotCube's own; the bot's image copies it beside it.

provider.description: Whose model it is: a Session's Turns all run on its first Turn's provider.
Whose model it is: a Session's Turns all run on its first Turn's provider.

models.description: The models a User picks from; the first is the default.

skills.description: Skill directories, relative to this file, each holding a SKILL.md; the bot's image copies them beside it.

userTokenInShell.description: Whether the agent's shell holds the Turn's signed user token as BOTCUBE_USER_TOKEN, for the bot's CLIs to call its own service as the User; absent, it does not. Only for a bot with its own service.

theme.description: The agent's four colours, for its illustrations; absent, BotCube's own. The avatar is the Agent Identity's.

memory.description: Whether the agent keeps a Memory across Sessions, and the Agent Profile shows it.

enabled.description: Whether the Agent Profile shows the open chat's Agent Computer.

liveBrowser.description: Whether the agent's browser floats over the chat while a Turn drives it.

profileOmitsCookieDomains.description: Domains, subdomains included, whose cookies BotCube deletes before saving the Agent Computer's browser profile, such as a site a product's own service seeds sign-ins for.
